quest.title: The Day the Sword Departs
quest.description: The day Sun Yu will depart from Liyue Harbor is fast approaching...

dialogues.speaker: Sun Yu
dialogues.text: Liyue... I wonder when I'll come back...

dialogues.speaker: Sun Yu
dialogues.text: Well, my itinerary to Fontaine has finally been decided, and in a few days, I'll set off with that merchant.

dialogues.speaker: Sun Yu
dialogues.text: He's still got some business stuff to deal with. And I'm taking advantage of this time to make sure I've packed everything.

choices.text: You are not going to visit Jueyun Karst one last time?

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: Haha, I might regret my decision if I were to do that.

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: I'll just take a look around the city from here. I've lived here for so long, and this time, I don't even know when I'll be able to come back.

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: Oh, by the way, Que'er... *sigh* She hasn't agreed to go with me in the end, but I already asked Zhiruo to take care of her.

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: I've also left some of my savings to her. She's much brighter than I am. She can take care of herself.

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: And perhaps one day, she'll understand my decision.

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: Right, Traveler, can I ask you one more favor?

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: Could you please fetch me some soil?

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: For someone like me who is about to leave his hometown, he'd want to bring some souvenirs with him, right?

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: With Liyue's soil carried with me, I can at least say that I haven't been completely disconnected from this land.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Why don't you fetch it yourself?

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: Hahaha... Like I said, if I were to walk around this place, tons of memories would sure come flooding back...

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: And then, I'm afraid that the little courage I've finally mustered to leave my hometown would disappear.

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: So, I can only leave the task to you, Traveler. I'll mark the location for you.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What's so special about that place?

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: Ahem... I used to practice my swordsmanship with Que'er there...

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: Anyway! I'll be leaving the task to you, Traveler.

choices.text: What do you need it for?
You are not going to walk around this place one last time?

talks.objective: Collect some soil for Sun Yu

dialogues.speaker: Sun Yu
dialogues.text: Thank you, it should be enough.

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: Ahahaha... Sorry, I don't want to put you out or anything...

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: It's just that I still feel a little reluctant to suddenly leave Liyue, where I've lived for so long.

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: Once the supplies are ready, we will set off.

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: Oh yes, the adventurer who took me to The Chasm will also travel with us.

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: Hearing that I'm heading over to Fontaine, she said she was also intrigued and decided to come with us.

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: The merchant is happy to have another adventurer to protect him. But to be honest, I'm really not good at communicating with people who are that enthusiastic... *sigh*

response.speaker: Sun Yu
response.text: Never thought that I'd travel this far one day...

dialogues.speaker: Little Que'er
dialogues.text: He must've been on purpose, Zhiruo! He just... He just doesn't want to be with me! *whimper*

dialogues.speaker: Zhiruo
dialogues.text: Que'er, you and he have spent so much time together, he must know what you're thinking.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiruo
dialogues.text: This time, he's determined to leave Liyue and travel abroad, he must have his reasons. So what's the harm if you travel with him?

dialogues.speaker: Little Que'er
dialogues.text: I just don't want to leave here! What's wrong with us staying here forever? The Guhua Clan... I couldn't care less about the Guhua Clan!

dialogues.speaker: Zhiruo
dialogues.text: Then why don't you tell him that?

dialogues.speaker: Little Que'er
dialogues.text: I... *sigh* He's been drawn to the whole idea of reviving the Clan. If he knew I'd said that, he must hate me...

dialogues.speaker: Sun Yu
dialogues.text: Traveler, did you bring back the soil for me?

dialogues.speaker: Sun Yu
dialogues.text: I'll be leaving the task to you, Traveler.
